variants.bio:
Lord X is not a conventional demon, nor is he the original Sonic possessed; he is a primordial, malevolent cosmic entity composed entirely of a substance known as Void Matter (VOID matter). He was born and has existed for eons in the Void, a dimension of absolute digital and spiritual nothingness completely external to the SEGA universe.

In the year 2011, this entity managed to rip open a rift into the human world through the internet and discovered the Sonic the Hedgehog franchise. Lord X became completely fascinated by the blue hedgehog, viewing him as the perfect vessel to interact with mortals. Utilizing his immense quantum-warping powers, he molded his own gaseous matter to mimic Sonic's appearance and created a cursed video game on a computer disc with one single goal: to lure human souls into his dimension to "play with them" for all eternity.
